headline: BOLIDEN SNAPS UP 64.68% OF NEXA RESOURCES FOR $1.3B — ZINC PRODUCTION JUMPS 62%, SILVER 64% WITH SOUTH AMERICAN EXPANSION
snippet: Swedish miner Boliden entered a definitive agreement on August 27, 2026 to acquire Votorantim's 64.68% controlling stake in Nexa Resources (NYSE: NEXA | TSX: NEXA) in an all-share transaction implying approximately $1.3 billion at $15.29 per Nexa share, with a voluntary cash tender offer to follow for the public float. The deal closes expected in Q1 2027, pending Boliden shareholder and regulatory approvals, and would increase Boliden's mined zinc by 62%, copper by 14%, and silver by 64% — adding 12 mines and smelters across Europe and Latin America. Votorantim receives approximately 7% of Boliden as part of the exchange, underscoring the conviction Nexa's controlling shareholder has placed in the combined company's prospects.

headline: PIRATE GOLD (YARR) DRILLS 89.7 g/t AU CORE WITHIN NEW GOLD STRUCTURE AT MOOSEHEAD — THIRD DISTINCT HIGH-GRADE ZONE OPENS AT TREASURE ISLAND
snippet: Pirate Gold Corp. (TSXV: YARR) announced today that drilling at the Moosehead Zone of its Treasure Island Project in Central Newfoundland has identified a new gold structure — separate from the Rib Vein and Eastern Trend — returning 30.6 g/t Au over 1.35m (including 89.7 g/t Au over 0.40m) and 4.25 g/t Au over 6.65m in holes targeting the new zone. The discovery enlarges the total number of distinct high-grade structures at Moosehead to at least three, in a project spanning 90 km of strike along the Valentine Lake Fault Zone — Canada's newest major gold district — with 11 drill rigs currently active at Treasure Island.

headline: COPPER RETREATS FROM RECORD $6.55/LB AS LME STOCKS REBUILD — ZIJIN WARNS KAMOA-KAKULA FLOODING CUTS 57,000 TONNES FROM 2026 OUTPUT
snippet: LME copper futures fell on August 26 from a record high close as exchange inventories rose toward 238,000 tonnes — about 16% above February lows — easing the squeeze that drove metal to an all-time close. However, Zijin Mining warned August 24 that seismic-triggered flooding at the Kamoa-Kakula complex in the DRC is set to cut Zijin's 57,000-tonne share of 2026 output, threatening Zijin's 1.2-million-tonne global copper target; Ivanhoe Mines had already revised Kamoa-Kakula's full-year guidance to 290,000–330,000 tonnes from 380,000–420,000 tonnes. The supply picture remains genuinely two-sided heading into Q4: U.S. import flows have drained stockpiles elsewhere while one of the world's largest copper mines continues its recovery from a major natural disaster.

headline: CYGNUS METALS DRILLS 20.3m @ 4.2 g/t AuEq INCLUDING 3.4m @ 14.2 g/t AuEq AT CHIBOUGAMAU — COPPER RAND ZONE OPEN ALONG STRIKE, RESOURCE UPDATE PENDING
snippet: Cygnus Metals (TSXV: CYG | ASX: CY5) released August 27 drill results from five holes totalling 3,830 metres at the Copper Rand prospect within the Chibougamau Copper-Gold Project in Quebec, stepping out 200m along strike from the historic mine to confirm continuity of a high-grade structure. Best interval: 20.3m at 4.2 g/t AuEq from 399.1m depth (including 3.4m at 14.2 g/t AuEq — 2.0 g/t Au, 8.5% Cu, 47.1 g/t Ag), with a second hole returning 5.1m at 5.3 g/t AuEq from 328.7m. Copper Rand sits 3km from Cygnus's 900ktpa Central Processing Facility — meaning any resource definition translates directly to near-term mill feed, and the structure remains open along strike.

headline: FREEPORT FUNDS 1,600m EXPANSION AT FINLAY MINERALS PIL — TOTAL DRILL TO 4,400m ON BC COPPER-GOLD PORPHYRY, NOW 2,700m IN
snippet: Finlay Minerals (TSXV: FYL) announced today that Freeport-McMoRan Mineral Properties Canada Inc. has exercised its option to fund an additional 1,600m at the PIL Property in north-central British Columbia, expanding the 2026 program to 4,400m under the Year 2 PIL Earn-In Agreement. Over 2,700m has already been drilled at the Gold and Reef targets, testing a 900m × 1,400m copper-gold-molybdenum soil anomaly located north of Freeport and Amarc's JOY copper porphyry — one of the largest undiscovered porphyry targets in BC's Golden Triangle fringe. Freeport's decision to expand drilling mid-program is a meaningful signal: the world's largest publicly traded copper company does not fund extra metres without encouragement from the core.

headline: LITHIUMBANK CLOSES $5.4M RAISE TODAY TO FULLY FUND BOARDWALK BRINE FEASIBILITY STUDY IN NORTHWEST ALBERTA
snippet: LithiumBank Resources Corp. (TSXV: LBNK) is closing a non-brokered private placement of 9,000,000 units at $0.60 per unit for gross proceeds of $5.4 million today, August 28, with net proceeds directed to completion of the feasibility study at its Boardwalk Lithium Brine Project in northwest Alberta. Boardwalk is one of Canada's most advanced undeveloped lithium brine assets targeting direct lithium extraction (DLE) technology, which has become increasingly strategic as lithium carbonate prices have risen 29% year-to-date on CATL's stalled Jianxiawo mine restart and tightening brine-source supply chains. A completed feasibility study positions LithiumBank for potential strategic partnerships or offtake agreements in a market where non-Chinese DLE projects command premium interest.

headline: SEEKING ALPHA: GOLD & SILVER MINERS "LOW-HANGING FRUIT" — P/NAV DISCOUNTS PERSIST AS PRODUCER MARGINS HIT ALL-TIME HIGHS ON $4,500+ GOLD
snippet: Seeking Alpha analysts identify gold and silver mining equities as structurally mispriced relative to current metal prices, naming 15 specific stocks as top speculative candidates in a bull case targeting $7,000 gold and $200 silver within 2-3 years. During the gold correction earlier this year, miners suffered 27%+ drawdowns as institutional investors fled the sector — creating compressed price-to-NAV multiples that contrast sharply with record operating margins on $4,500+ gold. The analysis argues the current setup mirrors 2016 and 2020 inflection points when a combination of record margins, depressed multiples, and forced institutional capitulation preceded multi-year outperformance by mining equities versus the underlying metals.

headline: CENTRAL BANKS BUY RECORD 288.9 TONNES IN Q2 AS GOLD POSTS 13% MONTHLY GAIN — GOLDSILVER.COM: THREE DATA PRINTS FLIPPED RATE HIKE CALCULUS
snippet: GoldSilver.com's August 28 gold outlook reports that three consecutive soft macro data prints this week — jobs, CPI, and PPI all below forecast — drove September rate-hike odds from 50% to 31% and catalyzed gold's best monthly gain since January at 13%. The structural case rests on central banks buying a quarterly record 288.9 tonnes of gold in Q2 2026 (up 62% year-over-year), including significant purchases by non-Western sovereigns at prices below current levels — a signal of institutional conviction on gold's role as a reserve asset that goes well beyond tactical positioning. The analysis notes that generalist Western capital rotation into miners has barely begun, arguing that the $4,500 gold price level still understates producer equity fair value by a wide margin.

headline: GOLDSILVER.COM: SILVER "BARELY OWNED" AND DOWN 47% IN REAL TERMS — THE STRUCTURAL CASE FOR FURTHER GAINS BEYOND AUGUST'S RECORD MONTHLY SURGE
snippet: GoldSilver.com's silver price outlook for August 2026 argues that despite the metal's strongest monthly gain in modern history, silver remains dramatically under-owned relative to historical institutional portfolio allocations and is still approximately 47% below its inflation-adjusted all-time highs — suggesting the current $69-70 per ounce price represents early-stage rather than late-stage appreciation in a structural multi-year bull market. The supply-deficit backdrop — entering its sixth consecutive year of a global shortfall — combined with accelerating industrial demand from solar panel manufacturing, EV motors, and AI data centre infrastructure means the metal's fundamentals are tightening faster than the price action yet implies. Most generalist fund managers still have zero silver allocation, and the opportunity cost of under-ownership is rising sharply.

headline: PROSPECTIVA RESOURCES COMMENCES MAIDEN 2,500m DRILL AT SAO FRANCISCO CU-AU PROJECT IN BRAZIL — FIRST HOLE COMPLETE, SECOND UNDERWAY
snippet: Prospectiva Resources Corp. (TSXV: PSVA) announced today that its maiden diamond drilling programme is underway at the São Francisco Copper-Gold Project in Brazil, comprising 2,500m across 10 holes — with the first hole complete and drilling now at hole two. The programme is designed to test the geometry and grade continuity of surface copper-gold targets identified through prior soil sampling, rock sampling, and geophysical surveys, and is expected to conclude by November 2026. São Francisco sits in a geologically prospective region of Brazil that has seen increasing major-company attention for copper-gold porphyry and skarn systems following recent deposit discoveries nearby.
